title: Landlord Conversation
userGoal: Ask about rent, utilities, repairs, and move-in details clearly.
starterPrompts: El alquiler incluye agua o internet?
culturalNotes: Housing conversations may move quickly once money and timing come up.
It helps to ask about services, deposit, and repairs one detail at a time.
Formal phrasing is usually safer than slang in rental conversations.
likelyMisunderstandings: The learner may confuse rent, deposit, and monthly services.
The landlord may mention contract details or move-in dates quickly.
The learner may ask about repairs without first confirming who pays.

variants.title: Apartment tour
variants.setup: You are standing in the apartment during a short walkthrough.
variants.localReplyStyle: The owner answers directly and may switch between rent, utilities, and timing.
variants.pressureNote: Listen for numbers, dates, and included services in the same reply.
variants.starterPrompt: El alquiler incluye agua y internet?

variants.title: WhatsApp rental question
variants.setup: You are sending a practical question by message before visiting the property.
variants.localReplyStyle: The landlord keeps the reply short and expects one clear question at a time.
variants.pressureNote: You may need to repeat the key point if the answer comes back too fast.
variants.starterPrompt: Nos puede confirmar el deposito y la fecha de entrada?

variants.title: Repair follow-up
variants.setup: You already rent the place and want to ask about a small fix.
variants.localReplyStyle: The owner may ask whether the issue is urgent or if someone can visit today.
variants.pressureNote: Focus on the repair word, the room, and the timing.
variants.starterPrompt: Hay un problema con la ducha en el bano.

turns.title: Open the rental question
turns.learnerGoal: Ask about rent, deposit, or the first available date.
turns.prompt: Buenos dias. Que duda tiene sobre la propiedad?
turns.repairCue: If the learner is vague, narrow it to one practical detail like rent or move-in date.

branchOptions.label: Ask about move-in
branchOptions.prompt: Cuando podemos entrar a la propiedad?

turns.title: Clarify what is included
turns.learnerGoal: Check whether utilities, internet, or maintenance are included.
turns.prompt: El deposito es de un mes y el agua si esta incluida.
turns.repairCue: If the learner misses the included services, repeat only that part.

branchOptions.label: Confirm water
branchOptions.prompt: Entonces el agua esta incluida, verdad?

branchOptions.label: Ask about internet
branchOptions.prompt: Y el internet tambien esta incluido?

turns.title: Ask for next steps
turns.learnerGoal: Confirm the next step for visit, contract, or repair.
turns.prompt: Le mando el contrato y coordinamos la visita para manana.
turns.repairCue: If the learner only says yes, ask them to repeat the next step or date.

branchOptions.label: Set the visit
branchOptions.prompt: Perfecto. Entonces coordinamos la visita para manana.

branchOptions.label: Ask for the contract
branchOptions.prompt: Si, por favor. Me manda el contrato por mensaje?

followUpDrills.title: Say the rent question cleanly
followUpDrills.goal: Ask the monthly rent in one direct sentence.

followUpDrills.title: Separate included from extra
followUpDrills.goal: Practice asking what is included and what is extra.
followUpDrills.prompt: Que incluye el alquiler? / Que no incluye?

followUpDrills.title: Shadow a tour answer
followUpDrills.goal: Repeat a realistic landlord reply at natural speed.
followUpDrills.prompt: El deposito es de un mes y el agua si esta incluida.
steps: Repeat again with the same rhythm.

followUpDrills.title: Dictate the deposit line
followUpDrills.goal: Write the deposit and date details you hear.
followUpDrills.prompt: El deposito es de un mes y la entrada puede ser manana.

followUpDrills.title: Split rent and utilities
followUpDrills.goal: Let one partner ask about rent while the other asks about included services.
followUpDrills.prompt: Partner A asks about rent. Partner B asks about water, internet, or repairs.
steps: Partner A asks the rent question.
Partner B asks what is included.

coupleSupport.sharedGoal: One partner handles money and timing while the other handles included services and repairs.
partnerRoles: Partner A asks about rent and deposit
Partner B asks about water, internet, and repairs
handoffPrompts: Ahora tu pareja pregunta por el deposito.
Tu turno: confirma si el agua y el internet estan incluidos.
coupleSupport.keepBothInvolvedTip: Split money, timing, and repair questions between both learners so the stronger speaker does not carry the whole exchange.

listeningCues.previewLine: El deposito es de un mes y podemos coordinar la entrada para manana.
